senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. צַפְרָא) the sparkling morning lights.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:4">Y. Ḥag. II, beg. 77ᵃ</cite> (interpret <he>עושה שחר עיפה</he>, <cite ref="Amos 4:13">Am. IV, 13</cite>) <he>אילין צ׳ תוהו וכ׳</he> (he turns) the morning lights into voidness, darkness and obscurity.
